First sight waits before movement, aim or abilities
Standard reaction does not fire at 200 ms

Intent cadence prevents repeated calls while cooldown snapshot remains ready
Duplicate authority tick neutralizes held controls
Actual thin wall loses target without tracking new hidden position
Reappearance requires a new reaction window
No friendly, dead, unobserved, rear, elevated or out-of-range acquisition
Exact distance ties use stable identity, not array order
Visible near-equal target retention avoids selection oscillation
Aim turns within profile rate instead of snapping to a new target
Unapplied turn cannot accumulate fictional local authority aim
